name: wave-kit
description: Install and compose the open React design system behind jay.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Compose interfaces with the jay.ai component kit.
interface.longDescription: Guides agents to install Wave Kit and build with the real React components, named Tailwind tokens, progressive image lightbox, navigation, and generative wave field used by jay.ai.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Wave Kit to build this interface with jay.ai's visual language.
